stem: A technician finishes in a room with a suspected pest issue and is assigned next to a clean propagation area. What is the best transition practice?
choices: Move directly if no insects are visible on clothing
Complete the facility changeover procedure for hands, footwear, clothing, tools and movement before entering the cleaner area
Carry the same tools into propagation and wipe them only if visibly dirty
Enter propagation first and sanitize at the end of the shift
rationale: Biosecurity controls movement of people, tools and materials between risk zones. The defined changeover procedure should occur before entering the cleaner area.
